I've been going on criticizing our ethics, praising European ethics, you guys are probably thinking I've betrayed Confucianist-Mencianist values. I'd like to tell you this, I had held Confucianist-Mencianist morality in high regard ever since I learned a thing or two about it. Surely, Confucianism-Mencianism is good, but where are we going to look for it now? Bring it back from China? Search for it in Vietnamese records? I don't think we could find it even if we lit up some torches, because Vietnam as well as China have long abandoned it.
Confucianism-Mencianism is not the monarchs' authoritarianism you guys think it is, no. Confucianism-Mencianism teaches reciprocal respect among monarchs and subjects, it's actually about equity; monarchs and subjects all need morality and ethics, meaning that subjects have to respect their monarchs like their own parents, and monarchs also have to love their subjects like their own children.
